title: Research Pharmacist & Pharmacy Technician
description:
MU-JHU Research Collaboration is seeking qualified candidates for the following positions:

**1. Research Pharmacist (1 position)**

**2. Pharmacy Technician (2 positions)**

Job descriptions are available on the MU-JHU website.

**How to Apply:**
Applications, including a complete CV with 3 referees and contacts, academic certificates and testimonials, should be emailed to the MU-JHU Human Resource Director at **hr@mujhu.org** by **3rd September 2026, 5:30pm**.

⚠️ Applications should not exceed 15MB.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

**Website:** www.mujhu.org
